pr.title: Visit all debug info in MIR Visitor
pr.description: I've been experimenting with simplifying debug info in MIR inliner, and discovered that MIR Visitor doesn't reliably visit all spans. This PR adds the missing visitor calls.
pr.author: kornelski

analysis.originalLogic: MIR's generated visitor (`make_mir_visitor!` in `compiler/rustc_middle/src/mir/visit.rs`) is intended to traverse all embedded source/debug spans. Before this PR, `super_terminator` destructured `TerminatorKind::Call`/`TailCall` with `fn_span: _`, so `fn_span` was never passed to `visit_span`; `super_local_decl` called `visit_source_info(source_info)` only after `visit_ty(... TyContext::LocalDecl { source_info, ... })`. Separately, inlining's `Integrator` implementation skipped `super_terminator` entirely for `TerminatorKind::Return`, so that terminator's `source_info` was not visited while other terminators were.
analysis.incorrectTransformation: The historical visitor/inliner behavior was an incomplete traversal rather than a rewrite: it left `fn_span` unvisited for `Call` and `TailCall`, visited a local declaration's `source_info` only after visiting its type, and, during inlining, omitted visiting the `source_info` of `Return` terminators because the `Return` case intentionally bypassed `super_terminator`. A span-rewriting visitor (notably inlining debug-info handling) could therefore miss or fail to update spans that the visitor contract says should be visited.
analysis.inputDomain: MIR bodies that contain `Call` and/or `TailCall` terminators with nontrivial `fn_span`, local declarations carrying `source_info`, and `Return` terminators processed by the inlining integrator. The comparison is between a visitor that traverses those fields and one that omits them, on otherwise identical MIR.
analysis.summary: A bug-fix PR completing MIR visitor coverage: `super_terminator` now visits `fn_span` for `Call` and `TailCall`, `super_local_decl` visits `source_info` before the type, and the inliner's `Integrator` visits `source_info` for `Return` terminators. This matters when inlining rewrites debug spans: incomplete visiting leaves some spans stale or unprocessed.
analysis.trigger: Any MIR transformation whose visitor overrides `visit_span`/`visit_source_info` and relies on the visitor to reach all embedded spans, especially inlining of calls and handling of `Return` terminators.
preconditions: The MIR contains `Call` or `TailCall` terminators whose `fn_span` is meaningful.
Local declarations carry `source_info`, and a visitor may mutate spans/source info while also visiting the declared type.
The inliner processes a `Return` terminator; `Integrator` skips `super_terminator` for `Return`, so its `source_info` must be visited explicitly.
pitfalls: Skipping `super_terminator` for `Return` to avoid other work also skips traversal of `terminator.source_info`; handle it separately in the `else` branch.
`fn_span` is a terminator-level debug span distinct from the call operands and must be visited explicitly; pattern-matching it as `fn_span: _` silently drops it.

In `super_local_decl`, `source_info` must be visited before `visit_ty` because `TyContext::LocalDecl` passes that same `source_info`; visiting it afterward can leave the type context observing stale span data.
Do not assume that adding visitor calls is behavior-preserving for debug info: without the calls, span-rewriting visitors silently fail to update those locations.
analysis.testStrategy: Construct two MIR inputs differing only in the presence of a `Call`/`TailCall` with a distinct `fn_span`, a local decl with `source_info`, and a `Return` terminator inside inlined code. Instrument a test visitor that records every `visit_span`/`visit_source_info` call, then assert the corrected visitor reaches the call `fn_span`, visits local `source_info` before `visit_ty`, and visits the inlined `Return` terminator's `source_info`. Prefer a `mir-opt`/debuginfo regression test that checks the resulting spans after inlining. The supplied patch contains no regression test changes, so no execution or reproduction was performed here.
evidence: Visit all debug info in MIR Visitor
I've been experimenting with simplifying debug info in MIR inliner, and discovered that MIR Visitor doesn't reliably visit all spans. This PR adds the missing visitor calls.
